newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares ease at close after mixed session.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares ease at close after mixed session.

text.p: * New Zealand shares end marginally lower
* Trade was patchy
* Air NZ eases slightly after broker profit downgrades
Price movements at close
LAST CHG
337 -2 * NZSC cap index -6.75 at 5,199.16
359 -1 * Volume NZ$54 million. Futures +5 at 1,225
754 +2 * Other movers - +6 -6
New Zealand shares ended marginally lower after a patchy Wednesday session, the NZSE-40 Capital Index losing 5.29 to close at 2,427.21.
Turnover, though, was a reasonable NZ$54 million.
Phil Hardie Boys at BZW said the market appeared to be supported by one buyer in the face of selling pressure.
"The market has had a pretty good run and it's probably looking to have a few profits taken," he said.
Air NZ was a little weaker after profit downgrades, brought about by the impact of increased jet fuel prices.
Brokers now expect the company to report an annual profit of around NZ$180 million from an earlier expected $200 million.
Air NZ "A" shares were off three cents at NZ$2.76 while the "B" shares dropped six to close at $3.90.
Air NZ declined to comment on the downgrades.
